normalizedEbayEvidence.description:
Brand new, factory sealed.  No rips/tears in plastic wrap but unfortunately the case was damaged at some point (pictured).

All sealed games receive two layers of protective packaging. Each game is first placed inside a polybag that is folded over but left unsealed. This added layer helps prevent unnecessary wear or damage to the shrink wrap during transit while also making it easier for the buyer to remove the game without having to cut the packaging open and risk accidentally damaging the original wrap.

For used games, we take the extra precaution of placing protective bubble material inside the case to help keep the disc securely in place during transit. Unfortunately, this is not possible with new, factory-sealed games without compromising the original packaging. As a result, there is always a possibility that the disc may become dislodged from its original seating during shipping. While we take every precaution to package items securely, this is an unavoidable risk when shipping sealed games.

*A Note About Sealed Games*
Our sealed games are not sold with the intention of being submitted for grading. We specialize in older games, and as a result, some items may exhibit varying degrees of shelf or storage wear, even if those imperfections are not clearly visible in the listing photos. Any noticeable rips or tears in the original plastic will be noted above, however, even when no damage is specifically mentioned, minor imperfections may still be present. Over time, small amounts of dust or debris can work their way beneath loose or imperfectly seated portions of the shrink wrap, including small flaps or ventilation holes. We strive to accurately represent the condition of every item, but please keep in mind that sealed games are older collectibles and may not have the pristine appearance of newly manufactured products. We encourage buyers to keep this in mind when purchasing.

Please see all photos provided as they are of the actual item you will receive.  Feel free to reach out with any questions or to request additional photos PRIOR to purchasing.
